items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: After you left Kidney you went to Piron's band

ctx.x: I think he died. He was playing after Lavella, a classy dance hall. And a guitar? Guitar, he got killed. You know Walter Decker or Becker? Yeah. But he was one of the Walter killed him. Oh, Butler, right. Gae. Gae, yeah. He was playing banjos at the time. Anyway, but after you left Kidney you went to Piron's band, I mean to Pitebuka's band.
After you left Kidney, you went to Piron's band? I mean to Pitebuka's band.
Yeah. After you left Kidney, you went to Piron's band.
